card.name: Sulfite and radiation safety section text
card.fires_on: Words right after a drug name or section number in warnings, such as the comma or 'contains' after 'sodium metabisulfite', and 'Radiation' in headings like '5.2 Radiation Risks'. Also seen on linking words in excipient or latex statements.

modes.label: Sulfite allergy statements
modes.description: The comma, 'contains' or 'a' around 'contains sodium metabisulfite, a sulfite that may cause allergic-type reactions'.
modes.example: Bupivacaine Hydrochloride and Epinephrine Injection contains sodium metabisulfite<<,>> a sulfite that may cause allergic-type

modes.label: Radiation section headings
modes.description: The word 'Radiation' in numbered headings such as Radiation Risks or Radiation Safety.
modes.example: 2.1<< Radiation>> Safety – Drug Handling Handle Thallous

modes.label: Excipient and latex wording
modes.description: Linking words like 'including' or 'with' in lists of ingredients or latex statements.
modes.example: Not made<< with>> natural rubber latex.
